notes: Canonical CaC Awoken records. Character-only forms are excluded. Requirements are separated from mechanics so unresolved or patch-sensitive gates can remain explicitly unverified.

records.name: Kaioken
records.mechanics_summary: Progressive stages increase offense while sharply increasing stamina-management risk; higher stages trade safety for power.

records.name: Potential Unleashed
prerequisites: Meet the required ranks on prior Advancement Tests
records.mechanics_summary: Universal balanced transformation with broad offensive and defensive benefits.

records.name: Beast
prerequisites: Complete the current Beast prerequisite chain
records.mechanics_summary: High-offense transformation with defensive trade-offs and enhanced combat properties.

records.name: Ultra Instinct
prerequisites: Complete the current Ultra Instinct prerequisite chain
records.mechanics_summary: Centers on automatic evasion and counterplay instead of a conventional flat damage multiplier.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.mechanics_summary: Two-stage transformation: the first stage emphasizes defense, speed, recovery and utility; the unleashed stage greatly increases pressure and resource recovery while adding health drain.

records.name: Super Saiyan
records.mechanics_summary: Three-stage Saiyan branch with escalating transformation effects.

records.name: Super Vegeta
records.mechanics_summary: Saiyan branch emphasizing Ki Blast-oriented output.

records.name: Future Super Saiyan
prerequisites: Complete the relevant post-story/Unknown History progression
records.mechanics_summary: Alternate Saiyan transformation with a distinct resource profile from the standard SS branches.

records.name: Super Saiyan God
prerequisites: Make the Super Saiyan God Shenron wish
Max friendship with Gohan and Videl
records.mechanics_summary: Saiyan god transformation with its own prerequisite chain rather than an extension of SS1–3.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
prerequisites: Meet the current Whis level requirement
records.mechanics_summary: Blue Saiyan branch with stronger output and ongoing resource pressure.

records.name: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan (Evolved)
prerequisites: Own Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan
Meet the current Whis/Vegeta friendship and level requirements
records.mechanics_summary: Advanced Blue form with increased offensive potential and greater resource demands.

records.name: Purification
prerequisites: Complete the current Majin progression requirement
records.mechanics_summary: Transforms the Majin CaC into a Kid Buu-like combat state and changes the available combat behavior.

records.name: Become Giant
prerequisites: Complete the current Namekian progression requirement
records.mechanics_summary: Giant-form transformation with a distinct combat state and resource behavior.

records.name: Turn Golden
prerequisites: Complete the current Frieza Race progression requirement
records.mechanics_summary: Frieza Race transformation focused on Ki-based offense.

records.name: Power Pole Pro
prerequisites: Complete the current Earthling progression requirement
records.mechanics_summary: Unique Earthling transformation that changes combat style and provides the Power Pole combat state.
